parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

set system services ssh root-login allow.command: set system services ssh root-login allow

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: 是否允许root用户登录，例如allow。

set system login user root authenticatio.template: set system login user [parameter1] authentication public-keys generate rsa modulus [parameter2]
set system login user root authenticatio.command: set system login user root authentication public-keys generate rsa modulus 2048
set system login user root authenticatio.explanation: 为root用户生成RSA公钥，用于SSH认证。

set system login class netadmin allow-co.template: set system login class [parameter1] allow-commands [parameter2] allow-rules to [parameter3]
set system login class netadmin allow-co.command: set system login class netadmin allow-commands ssh allow-rules to root
set system login class netadmin allow-co.explanation: 配置登录类允许的命令和规则。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.3.3/16
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。
